description: A centered line that overflows starts at the left edge and ends in the ellipsis.

florui.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
florui.css: .p { width: 90px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; text-align: center; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 5.52% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 9.02% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
